name: ISS US Lab Keepout Zones
notes: Keepout zones for US Laboratory module. Coordinates in ISS reference frame (meters).

zones.name: us_lab_port_rack
zones.notes: Equipment rack on port side of US Lab. Avoid due to protruding connectors and sensitive instruments.

zones.name: jpm_hatch_clearance
zones.notes: Clearance zone around JPM hatch. Required for crew passage safety.

zones.name: dock_maintenance_zone
zones.notes: Maintenance exclusion zone near docking station. Active during EVA prep.

zones.name: express_rack_7
zones.notes: EXPRESS Rack 7 with active experiments. High-sensitivity vibration zone.

zones.name: cupola_viewport
zones.notes: Cupola viewport area. Crew observation station - no robot transit.
